notes: Fixed the corner resize handles on the main image title: they can no longer be pushed off the canvas, and a corner is no longer stolen by the floating duplicate / delete buttons.
Every background category now has at least ten images, including new light scenes for Studio Light, Home, Outdoor, Nature, Sport, Leisure and Retail.
Festival backgrounds were rebuilt: the title now sits in the upper area so the product has the centre, and each one carries real festive elements (trees, lanterns, pumpkins, balloons and more).
The deselect button that covered the canvas was removed.
The text panel now has angle presets (-15/-5/+5/+15/+90 and reset), 16 colours and 16 effect and format buttons.
